san-jose-california.file_title: File:2012-07-15 San Jose 021 Downtown, Cathedral Basilica of St. Joseph.jpg
san-jose-california.author: Allie_Caulfield
san-jose-california.alt: The white Cathedral Basilica of St. Joseph in downtown San Jose, its two domed bell towers between palm trees and office towers under a clear blue sky.
san-jose-california.why: San Jose without the hotel front at Santana Row ("Hotel Valencia" on its facade; the round-4 review's R20). The brief's second preference, the Cathedral Basilica of St. Joseph with downtown: its portico and two bell towers between downtown's office towers, at noon in July, 6000px wide (the 1920px rendition applied). No downtown skyline found was as good: from Oak Hill and the hills the towers are a thin, hazy band, and none was found from Guadalupe River Park or over Plaza de Cesar Chavez in daylight at 1,600px or more.
san-jose-california.checked: the basilica's facade and towers, palms, office towers either side; no person as the subject (a few small figures on the steps); no sculpture or mural; no prominent logo (a row of newspaper boxes and three parked cars along the bottom edge, outside the 16:7 band's crop and small on the 16:10 card)

alternatives.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA
alternatives.note: the first preference's kind, the downtown skyline, but from Oak Hill Memorial Park to the south: the towers a thin band above autumn trees, under a grey-blue December sky
